digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md — close workflow documentation
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit; the implementation actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status.
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and close-gate configuration, but the docs present it as unconditional.
The precheck accepts a referencing commit for the ticket or any of its transitive descendants, but the docs do not describe the descendant subtree matching.

The stacked-workflow command 'rebar transition --ref <sha>' is documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md but is completely absent from AGENTS.md, causing agents to skip it and incorrectly conclude pre-land closes are impossible.

The --ref flag retargets verification and signature to a specific ref's tree but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, a distinction the docs must clarify to avoid substituting one wrong mechanism for another.
